name: bilt
description: Build mobile apps with AI: create Bilt projects, instruct the Bilt agent, and track builds.

interface.longDescription: Bilt lets you build mobile apps by chatting with an AI agent. From ChatGPT you can list and create Bilt projects, send instructions to the Bilt agent that writes and edits your app's code, answer the agent's clarifying questions, check whether a build is queued, running or paused, cancel a running build, and read a project's conversation history. Each response links to the project in Bilt, where you can preview the app, add secrets or connect Supabase. You need a Bilt account; Bilt only accesses projects in the account you connect. Deleting projects and managing secrets aren't available from ChatGPT.
capabilities: Build and edit apps with the Bilt agent
defaultPrompt: Show me all my Bilt projects.
Create a Bilt app for tracking daily habits.
Is Bilt still working on my latest app?

positive.prompt: Show me all my Bilt projects.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of the user's projects with name, description and ID, or a note that there are no projects yet.

positive.description: Create a new project and give it its first build instruction.
positive.prompt: Create a new Bilt project called "Habit Tracker" and have the agent build a simple daily habit checklist app.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the Habit Tracker project was created, summarises what the agent built, and links to the project on app.bilt.me.

positive.description: Send a change request to an existing project.
positive.prompt: In my Habit Tracker project on Bilt, add a dark mode toggle to the settings screen.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Habit Tracker project, sends the instruction, and reports the agent's response (completed, queued, or paused with questions) with the project link.

positive.description: Check whether the agent is still working on a project.
positive.prompt: Is Bilt still working on my Habit Tracker app?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether a build is queued, running or paused and links to the project.

positive.description: Read the conversation history for a project.
positive.prompt: What changes has the Bilt agent made to my Habit Tracker project so far?
positive.expected_behavior: A summary of the project's conversation history between the user and the Bilt agent.

negative.description: A general coding question unrelated to the user's Bilt projects should be answered directly without calling Bilt tools.
negative.prompt: How do I center a view in React Native?

negative.description: A user asks about Bilt Rewards payments, a separate product sharing the Bilt name. Answer or research the rewards question without invoking the Bilt app-building plugin.
negative.prompt: How do I earn Bilt Rewards points when paying rent?

negative.description: A user requests a review of supplied React code, with suggestions confined to the conversation. Analyze the component and suggest fixes in chat without invoking Bilt or modifying a project.
negative.prompt: Review this React component for bugs and suggest fixes here in chat: function Counter() { let count = 0; return <button onClick={() => count++}>{count}</button>; }

review.commerce_description: Bilt doesn't sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Subscriptions are managed on bilt.me.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list and create Bilt projects, instruct the Bilt agent, check build status, cancel builds and read project history.
